description: Hire an OpenTrain proposal with ADMIN_BALANCE funding: creates the contract plus the ACTIVE_FUNDED initial milestone with internal-balance funding metadata. Zero money moves and no approval record is created; the later milestone approval/release that moves money stays human-only in the web app. Internal, default-off surface for verified OpenTrain admins in the canonical admin organization — the admin_balance_hire:create scope alone never grants access (the server independently verifies platform-admin status, the Admin Pay allowlist, canonical-org membership, and the proposal organization; everything fails closed). Request-bound idempotency: same idempotencyKey + payload converges; key reuse with a changed payload conflicts; concurrency cannot duplicate the contract. The response carries a live `onboarding` receipt for the new hire’s auto-assigned Project To-dos (exact assignment readback, durable hook state, provider provisioning state; recomputed on every replay): `onboarding.status` COMPLETE is the only full success — PENDING, RETRYABLE_FAILED, or terminal FAILED is a PARTIAL SUCCESS: for PENDING/RETRYABLE_FAILED retry this tool with the SAME idempotencyKey to re-heal and re-check; for FAILED (error.retryable=false) follow error.remediation instead (a same-key retry cannot heal it); read opentrain_list_project_todos for the contract when you need current assignment truth.

idempotencyKey.description: Request-bound idempotency key (1-128 chars of letters, digits, dot, underscore, dash, colon). The same key with the same payload converges on the original result; reusing a key with a changed payload conflicts.

proposalId.description: OpenTrain proposal (job offer) id to hire with ADMIN_BALANCE funding.

name: opentrain_create_admin_balance_hire
